cards.text: Gideon is the man the LORD sent to save Israel from Midian (Judges 6:14). Now the Midianites, the Amalekites and other people of the east gather together, cross the Jordan, and camp in the Valley of Jezreel. That's not a visit, friend, that's a MOVE-IN.

cards.question: With an enemy army camped in the valley, what comes upon Gideon?

cards.text: Gideon blows the ram's horn, and the Abiezrites, his father Joash's people (Judges 6:11), rally behind him. Then he sends out messengers to call even more men to arms.

cards.question: True or false: Gideon sends his messengers only through Manasseh.

cards.text: Gideon says to God, "If You are going to save Israel by my hand, as You have said…" and then he lays out a test. He'll put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor overnight.

cards.question: What sign does Gideon ask God for with the fleece on the threshing floor?

answers.text: Dew only on the fleece and dry ground
Fire to burn up the fleece by morning
The fleece gone from the floor by dawn

cards.question: True or false: The next morning, the fleece is wet with dew and the ground is dry, just as Gideon asked.

Gideon wrings a bowlful of water out of the fleece. Then he says to God, "Do not be angry with me; let me speak one more time." True or false: For his second test, he asks God to make the fleece dry and the ground covered with dew.

cards.text: That night God does it: only the fleece is dry, and dew covers the ground. I get it, friend, because the timer says done, I can SMELL done, and I STILL open that oven one more time.
Early in the morning, Gideon and his men camp beside the spring of Harod, with Midian's camp north of them in the valley. Then the LORD tells Gideon there's a problem with his army.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD tells Gideon his army is too small to beat Midian.
Why does the LORD say Gideon has too many men?

answers.text: So Israel won't say their own hand saved them
So Midian won't see them coming from far off
So the march to the valley will go faster

cards.text: So the LORD gives Gideon an announcement to make: "Whoever is fearful and trembling may turn back and leave Mount Gilead."

cards.question: After Gideon's announcement, ___ of his men turn back.

cards.text: TWENTY-TWO THOUSAND go home, and ten thousand remain. The boss says anybody can head out early, and the parking lot is EMPTY in four seconds.
Then the LORD says, "There are still too many men." He has Gideon take the ten thousand down to the water so He can sift them there.

cards.question: Down at the water, how will the LORD separate the ten thousand men?

answers.text: By how each man drinks the water
By who can carry the most water
By who crosses the water first

cards.question: Most of the men kneel down to drink. How many lap the water with their hands to their mouths?
The LORD tells Gideon that with the men who lapped, He will ___ him and deliver the Midianites into his hand.

cards.text: So Gideon sends everyone else home and keeps the three hundred, who take charge of the others' provisions and rams' horns. Three hundred men up here, and down below in the valley lies the camp of Midian.
That night the LORD tells Gideon, "Get up and go down against the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand." Three hundred men against a WHOLE army, and the LORD says He has ALREADY delivered it.

cards.question: The LORD gives Gideon another option. If Gideon is afraid to attack, what should he do?

answers.text: Take his servant and listen in on the camp
Call back the men who went home
Send in the three hundred without him

cards.text: So Gideon and his servant Purah go down to the outposts, where armed men are guarding the camp. The Midianites, Amalekites and other people of the east have settled in the valley like a swarm of locusts, and their camels are as countless as the sand on the seashore.
As Gideon arrives, a man in the camp is telling his friend about a dream.

cards.question: In the man's dream, what comes tumbling into the Midianite camp?

answers.text: A great stone from the hills
A wild ox from the fields

cards.text: It hits a tent so hard the tent overturns and collapses. Friend, my best cookie EVER couldn't knock over a napkin.

cards.question: The man's friend hears about the loaf knocking the tent over. What does he say the dream means?

answers.text: God has given Midian to Gideon
Their camp will run out of water
A storm will hit the valley tonight

cards.question: True or false: When Gideon hears the dream and what it means, he bows in worship.

cards.text: Then Gideon heads back to Israel's camp and says, "Get up, for the LORD has delivered the camp of Midian into your hand."
He divides the three hundred into three companies. Each man gets a ram's horn in one hand and a large jar in the other.

cards.question: Gideon hands each of his three hundred men a large jar. Inside each jar is a ___.
True or false: Gideon tells his three hundred men to wait behind while he goes down to the camp alone.
Gideon tells his men to watch him and do as he does. When his group blows their horns, the others will blow theirs from all around the camp. What are they to shout?

answers.text: For the LORD and for Gideon
For our land and our people

cards.text: Gideon and the hundred men with him reach the outskirts of the camp at the beginning of the middle watch, just after the changing of the guard. Shhh.

cards.question: Gideon's men have horns in their hands and torches hidden inside jars. When the signal comes, what do they do with the jars?

cards.text: All three companies blow their horns, smash their jars and hold their torches, shouting, "A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!" That's three hundred smoke alarms going off at once, friend.

cards.question: True or false: Gideon's three hundred charge straight into the middle of the Midianite camp.
True or false: The entire Midianite army runs away, crying out as they go.
As the three hundred rams' horns sound, what does the LORD do inside the Midianite camp?

answers.text: Turns the men against one another
Sends hail down on their tents

cards.text: The army runs toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel-meholah. Men from Naphtali, Asher and all Manasseh are called out, and they chase the Midianites.
Then Gideon sends messengers all through the hill country of Ephraim. Everybody's in the group chat now, friend.

cards.question: Gideon tells the men of Ephraim to get ahead of the Midianites and seize the waters of the ___ as far as Beth-barah.

cards.text: The men of Ephraim do just that, capturing the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth-barah. They also capture Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian, killing Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb.

cards.question: The men of Ephraim keep chasing the Midianites and bring the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon. Where is Gideon?

answers.text: On the other side of the Jordan
Back at his home in Ophrah
In the hill country of Ephraim

cards.text: And that's where we pull this batch out for now, friend, because Gideon's story is NOT done.
